lines.zh: 我踩过的地方都是酥皮渣
lines.en: I leave pastry crumbs wherever I step

lines.zh: 翅膀像两片烤好的面包
lines.en: My wings look like two baked loaves
I waddle along, unsteady

lines.zh: 奶油从我的脚边滴下来
lines.en: Cream drips off my feet
The ridges on my body spiral round

lines.zh: 我闻起来像烤箱里出来的
lines.en: I smell like something fresh from an oven
I walk slowly, afraid of crumbling
There is sugar glaze on my horns

lines.zh: 我从灵魂熔炉的方向走来
lines.en: I come from the direction of the soul furnace
I shake loose a flake of crust
My warm body feels good

lines.zh: 我朝着有人味的地方走
lines.en: I head toward the smell of people
I sit by the furnace, warm and cozy
My tail curls into a ring
My crust hardens slowly in the wind
I sniff my own paw
The milky smell has not faded
I let out a tiny burp
Still small, my wings cannot yet hold me
A piece of me has been nibbled
I am waiting for three buckets of milk
The smell of an oven comforts me
I curl up to keep warm

lines.zh: 一圈一圈的酥皮很漂亮
lines.en: The spiral crust is beautiful
My ear flicks once

lines.zh: 这点奶油还能撑一会儿
lines.en: This cream will last a while
Are you going to take a bite of me

lines.zh: 我身上是可颂，不是面包
lines.en: I am a croissant, not plain bread

lines.zh: 你看我的时候在流口水
lines.en: You are drooling while you look at me
I am really not food
Feed me milk and I will follow
I am young, I need time to grow
Your hand comes close, and I get scared
My horns are not hard yet

lines.zh: 我站在炉子这边，比较安全
lines.en: I stand on the furnace side, it is safer
Do not put me in the oven
You smell like wheat
I recognize people by smell
Your hands are warm
You may look at me, just do not eat me
I blink once, slowly
We are not that close yet
Do not break me apart
A piece of my crust came off
It hurts, the cream is squeezing out
I shake and the glaze falls off

lines.zh: 酥皮掉了一地，奶油流出来。
lines.en: My pastry flakes everywhere and cream leaks out.
That squashed me flat
My horn is a bit blunt now
I cannot really take much
The wound smells of caramel
Give me a moment to recover
Milk, milk, I want milk
Where is the bucket, it must be a whole bucket
I smell it, that is milk
Three buckets, not one less
I rise on my toes to reach
Milk in my mouth and I perk right up
Bring the bucket and I will follow
Not a bowl, that is too small
I wag my tail while drinking

lines.zh: 喝完这桶，我们还熟一点
lines.en: One more bucket and we are closer
Do not bump me, I could crumble

lines.zh: 我晃了一下，掉了几粒渣
lines.en: I wobble and a few crumbs fall
You knocked off one of my corners
I am flaky, be gentle
Cream smeared onto your sleeve
I steadied myself, crust intact

lines.zh: 这么近，你闻到香味了吧
lines.en: This close, you must smell the butter
My horn poked you
Back up a bit, I fear being squashed
That does not count, I am not fully baked
Two croissants could share one oven
I know my own kind by their smell

lines.zh: 我还没长大，谈这个太早
lines.en: I am not grown, it is too early for that

lines.zh: 要找个不会把我吃掉的对象
lines.en: I need someone who will not eat me
Sleeping by the furnace together would be nice

lines.zh: 我们的酥皮会粘在一起
lines.en: Our crusts would stick together

lines.zh: 先闻一闻，对上味道再说
lines.en: Let us sniff first and see if the scents match
A partner should be sweet too
I edge over carefully, afraid to crumble
This matter can wait until I grow
I scoop it up in my paws
These crumbs count as mine too
I fumbled and it fell
I carry it in my mouth, afraid it melts

lines.zh: 这点东西可以放兜里吗
lines.en: Can I keep this in a pocket
My arms are too short to reach
I bury it in the cream
Picked it up and found sugar
It stuck to my paw
May I trade this for milk

lines.zh: 那个东西在动，我不喜欢
lines.en: That thing is moving, I do not like it
I puff myself up
The cream's sweetness turns bitter
I stare at it, wings spread
It is getting close to my master
I am going to slow it down
That is no croissant customer
I plant myself between you
My horns point at it
Stop it first, then we talk
I do not bite, but I do stick
I crouch, ready to charge
I turn to face it square
It does not like this smell either

lines.zh: 我的奶油已经糊住它的脚。
lines.en: My cream is already gumming up its feet.
It is slowing, perfect
Cream spreads around its feet
The distance between us shrinks
I hold this direction
It tries to go around, I turn with it
My wings are not much use

lines.zh: 它踩到了我留下的奶油
lines.en: It stepped in the cream I left
A bit more and it cannot move
I do not chase with speed, I chase with stickiness
I am slow, but it is slower
It circles around me
My scent is tangling it up
It is starting to lose its footing
Just a little longer now
I butt my head into it
Cream smeared on its legs
This is not a blow, it is sticking
My horn gives a shove
It slowed down, did it not

lines.zh: 我拍了拍翅膀，撒了糖霜
lines.en: I flap and scatter sugar glaze
That was not a fair move at all
I hold it, my master finishes

lines.zh: 我推了一把，它退了半步
lines.en: I shove, and it gives half a step
Do not worry, I hit soft
I press my whole body against it
Cream in its eyes
It is too stuck to lift a foot
That shove used all my weight
I break out of the croissant egg
The shell is like a baked crust
I still carry the furnace's warmth
I push the crack open with my nose
The first thing I smell is milk
My first cry is very soft
I cannot quite stand yet
This place is cooler than the furnace
I shake off the crumbs
Someone set me down here
My body has ridges in rings
First find milk, then find a master
I take a look at this world
I roll twice before finding my feet
The shell cracks with a crisp sound
I land still steaming
Baked too long, my crust is black

lines.zh: 从高处掉下，我摔成扁的了
lines.en: I fall from a height and land squashed
Soaked through, I am coming apart
The blast rattles me to pieces

lines.zh: 飞来的东西扎进了我的皮
lines.en: Something flying pierced my crust

lines.zh: 这道法术让我的奶油发苦
lines.en: That spell turns my cream bitter
No milk, and I go soft with hunger

lines.zh: 雷打在我身上，糖霜炸了
lines.en: Lightning hits and my glaze crackles

lines.zh: 虚空里没有炉火，冷得厉害
lines.en: No furnace in the void, and it is freezing
